admin.face_detection_description: Detect the faces in assets using machine learning. For videos, only the thumbnail is considered. "Refresh" (re-)processes all assets. "Reset" additionally clears all current face data. "Missing" queues assets that haven't been processed yet. Detected faces will be queued for Facial Recognition after Face Detection is complete, grouping them into existing or new people.

admin.frameleaf_cloud_ml_billing_body: You pay for the GPU time a job uses, per second, at twice what that GPU costs us, plus a start fee ({min} to {max}) for each worker that loads the model. Per-photo and per-minute prices are estimates from measured speed; long videos run in 30-second chunks on up to five workers.

admin.frameleaf_cloud_ml_billing_sentence_work: Billed by GPU time: {rate} per minute on a {gpu} plus a {fee} start fee per worker. Long videos run as {seconds} s chunks on {workers} workers, each with its own start fee.

A missing thumbnail or preview is only forgotten, so it can be made again. If a drive is unplugged or a folder has moved, everything on it is listed here: reconnect it and run the check again before you do this.

admin.frameleaf_maintenance_start_confirm_body: Everyone except administrators will see the maintenance page and be signed out. Uploads, mobile backups and shared links pause until maintenance mode ends.
admin.frameleaf_manager_move_intro: Move your photos to a bigger drive with Frameleaf Manager. It copies and checks the files before switching folders.
admin.frameleaf_manager_move_unavailable: This server has no configured Manager link. Use Manager to move to another drive, or follow the advanced checklist below.
admin.frameleaf_manager_new_server: For a new server, restore a complete backup that includes your photos and videos. A Manager database backup alone does not move the library.
admin.frameleaf_manager_sign_in: Sign in to Manager separately, then choose Storage. This link is configured by your server; it is not a connection check.
admin.frameleaf_migration_checklist_final: Migration preflight is ready for review. No files were moved.
admin.frameleaf_migration_checklist_intro: Move physical files without breaking ownership or references.

admin.frameleaf_migration_fact_rollback_value: Keep source until destination verification completes

admin.frameleaf_migration_report_error_foreign: This report contains file paths from a server or computer, so it was not opened. Run the verify command again to write a clean report.
admin.frameleaf_migration_report_error_inconsi: This report's counts do not agree with each other or with its verdict, so it cannot be trusted.
admin.frameleaf_migration_report_error_invalid: This report is incomplete or malformed.

admin.frameleaf_migration_report_error_read_fa: The file could not be read.
admin.frameleaf_migration_report_error_secret: This report contains credentials, such as an API key or a token, so it was not opened. Delete the file and do not share it.
admin.frameleaf_migration_report_error_too_lar: This file is too large to be a migration audit report.
admin.frameleaf_migration_report_error_unsuppo: This is not a current migration audit report. Run the verify command again to write one.

admin.frameleaf_migration_settings_subtitle: Take your library to a new server or a bigger drive, or take a copy out.
admin.frameleaf_migration_status_audit_incompl: The audit stopped before checking every original. This is not a pass.
admin.frameleaf_migration_status_dry_run_descr: A preview. Nothing was written to the destination, so it never clears the source.
admin.frameleaf_migration_status_incomplete_de: Some originals are missing or failed. Run the migration again, then verify.
admin.frameleaf_migration_status_pass_descript: Every original was verified on the destination by checksum.
admin.frameleaf_migration_step_dry_run_descrip: Lists what would move and what the destination already holds. Writes nothing to the destination and never counts as a pass.
admin.frameleaf_migration_step_keys_descriptio: Create an API key for the person being moved on each server. Type each key into the terminal when it waits for input; keys are never entered or saved on this page.
admin.frameleaf_migration_step_keys_title: Provide API keys in the terminal
admin.frameleaf_migration_step_preflight_descr: Checks both connections, key permissions, the owner on each side and any existing ledger. Changes nothing.
admin.frameleaf_migration_step_retry_descripti: Tries originals that failed on an earlier run again, adds them to their albums, and reattaches names once the destination has finished face detection.
admin.frameleaf_migration_step_run_description: Copies originals, then albums, tags, stacks and people. If it stops for any reason, run the same command again: the ledger resumes where it left off.
admin.frameleaf_migration_step_tool_descriptio: On the computer that will run the migration, from a checkout of the Frameleaf source. It needs network access to both servers and only a little free disk for files in flight.
admin.frameleaf_migration_step_verify_descript: Checks every original on the destination by checksum, without contacting the source, and writes the audit report next to the ledger. Open that report here.

admin.transcoding_max_b_frames_description: Higher values improve compression efficiency, but slow down encoding. May not be compatible with hardware acceleration on older devices. 0 disables B-frames, while -1 sets this value automatically.
admin.transcoding_max_bitrate_description: Setting a max bitrate can make file sizes more predictable at a minor cost to quality. At 720p, typical values are 2600 kbit/s for VP9 or HEVC, or 4500 kbit/s for H.264. Disabled if set to 0. When no unit is specified, k (for kbit/s) is assumed; therefore 5000, 5000k, and 5M (for Mbit/s) are equivalent.
admin.transcoding_max_keyframe_interval_descri: Sets the maximum frame distance between keyframes. Lower values worsen compression efficiency, but improve seek times and may improve quality in scenes with fast movement. 0 sets this value automatically.
admin.transcoding_optimal_description: Videos higher than target resolution or not in an accepted format
admin.transcoding_policy_description: Set when a video will be transcoded
admin.transcoding_preferred_hardware_device_de: Applies only to VAAPI and QSV. Sets the dri node used for hardware transcoding.
admin.transcoding_preset_preset_description: Compression speed. Slower presets produce smaller files, and increase quality when targeting a certain bitrate. VP9 ignores speeds above 'faster'.
admin.transcoding_realtime_description: Allows transcoding to be performed in real-time as the video is being streamed. Enables quality switching, but may cause higher playback latency and stuttering depending on server capabilities.
admin.transcoding_realtime_enabled_description: If disabled, the server will refuse to start new real-time transcoding sessions.
admin.transcoding_realtime_resolutions_descrip: The resolutions offered for real-time transcoding. Higher resolutions may cause playback issues if the server cannot transcode them quickly enough.
admin.transcoding_realtime_video_codecs_descri: The video codecs offered for real-time transcoding. Clients will choose the best option they support during playback. AV1 is more efficient than HEVC, which is more efficient than H.264. When using hardware acceleration, only select the codecs the accelerator can encode. When using software transcoding, note that H.264 is faster than AV1, which is faster than HEVC.
admin.transcoding_reference_frames_description: The number of frames to reference when compressing a given frame. Higher values improve compression efficiency, but slow down encoding. 0 sets this value automatically.
admin.transcoding_required_description: Only videos not in an accepted format
admin.transcoding_settings_description: Manage which videos to transcode and how to process them
admin.transcoding_target_resolution_descriptio: Higher resolutions can preserve more detail but take longer to encode, have larger file sizes, and can reduce app responsiveness.
admin.transcoding_temporal_aq_description: Applies only to NVENC. Temporal Adaptive Quantization increases quality of high-detail, low-motion scenes. May not be compatible with older devices.
admin.transcoding_threads_description: Higher values lead to faster encoding, but leave less room for the server to process other tasks while active. This value should not be more than the number of CPU cores. Maximizes utilization if set to 0.
admin.transcoding_tone_mapping_description: Attempts to preserve the appearance of HDR videos when converted to SDR. Each algorithm makes different tradeoffs for color, detail and brightness. Hable preserves detail, Mobius preserves color, and Reinhard preserves brightness.
admin.transcoding_transcode_policy_description: Policy for when a video should be transcoded. HDR videos and videos with a pixel format other than YUV 4:2:0 will always be transcoded (except if transcoding is disabled).
admin.transcoding_two_pass_encoding_setting_de: Transcode in two passes to produce better encoded videos. When max bitrate is enabled (required for it to work with H.264 and HEVC), this mode uses a bitrate range based on the max bitrate and ignores CRF. For VP9, CRF can be used if max bitrate is disabled.
admin.transcoding_video_codec_description: VP9 has high efficiency and web compatibility, but takes longer to transcode. HEVC performs similarly, but has lower web compatibility. H.264 is widely compatible and quick to transcode, but produces much larger files. AV1 is the most efficient codec but lacks support on older devices.

frameleaf_backup_keeps_union: A photo is kept when it matches any choice. Library data is always backed up in full.
frameleaf_backup_keeps_whole: Your choices cover your whole library.

frameleaf_backup_local_enabled: Take a snapshot with every backup

frameleaf_backup_local_failed: The snapshot didn’t finish. Try again in a moment.
frameleaf_backup_local_keep_help: Older snapshots are removed only after a new one succeeds.
frameleaf_backup_local_not_photos: This is not a backup of your photos
frameleaf_backup_local_not_photos_body: A snapshot holds your albums, people, edits and settings. It’s kept on this server, so it protects against mistakes, not against losing the server. Use Cloud Backup or Buddy Backup for your photos and videos.
frameleaf_backup_local_saved_description: Download one to keep elsewhere, or take the library data back to it. Restoring asks you to confirm first.
frameleaf_backup_places_description: Each place keeps its own copy, so losing one never costs you the others.

frameleaf_backup_recovery_scope: Recover your own backed-up content. Administrators can also recover library settings and the server. Incoming hosted vaults cannot be browsed here.
frameleaf_backup_recovery_unavailable: Recovery needs a Cloud-authorized pairing and your verified recovery key. Check authorization and import your kit below. A security block or expired recovery window prevents access.
frameleaf_backup_replacement_description: Sign in to Cloud and rebind your existing pairing to this server. Refresh authorization, then import your recovery kit or unlock the encrypted package below. An active subscription is not required for recovery.
frameleaf_backup_restore_data_body: Your photos are fine but the library got muddled. Go back to a snapshot.
frameleaf_backup_restore_dates: Dates you can go back to
frameleaf_backup_restore_dates_descripti: Every finished backup is a date you can restore from. Choose a place to open its restore steps.
frameleaf_backup_restore_dates_empty: No backup has finished yet, so there is nothing to go back to.
frameleaf_backup_restore_metadata: {count} album or collection records included, even when they contain no media.
frameleaf_backup_restore_needs_offsite: Needs Cloud Backup or Buddy Backup.
frameleaf_backup_restore_new_server_body: Replacing this server? Start on the new one with your recovery key or kit.
frameleaf_backup_restore_row_help: Restore photos, albums or the whole library from this backup.
frameleaf_backup_restore_some_body: Pick what you want from a backup and put it back in your library.
frameleaf_backup_restore_what_descriptio: Restoring never deletes a backup. You choose the date and see what will change before anything happens.
frameleaf_backup_restore_whole: The whole library, as it was
frameleaf_backup_restore_whole_body: Take this server back to an earlier date. Use this after a mistake or a damaged disk.
frameleaf_backup_schedule_custom_body: Backups run at times that were set outside this page, and they keep running as they are. To change them, choose how often to back up below; that replaces the custom schedule.
frameleaf_backup_schedule_custom_title: This server has a custom schedule
frameleaf_backup_schedule_description: One schedule for every backup. They run one after another, never at the same time.
frameleaf_backup_schedule_failed: The schedule could not be read. Check your connection and try again.
frameleaf_backup_schedule_first_longer: The first backup of a large library takes longer. If it is still going when the next start time comes, the next run begins as soon as it ends.
frameleaf_backup_schedule_gap_help: Counted from midnight on this server’s clock.
frameleaf_backup_schedule_no_stop: Backups have a start time and no stop time: each one carries on until it has finished, and the next run waits for it.
frameleaf_backup_schedule_nothing_on: No backup is switched on yet, so nothing runs at this time.
frameleaf_backup_schedule_one_after: Each backup starts when the one before it finishes. A place that is switched off is left out, and a backup that can’t run doesn’t hold up the next.
frameleaf_backup_schedule_start_help: Night is best: backups use your disk and internet.
frameleaf_backup_schedule_step_then: Starts when the one before it finishes
frameleaf_backup_state_behind: {days, plural, one {# day behind} other {# days behind}}
frameleaf_backup_state_buddy_pending: Waiting for your buddy to agree
frameleaf_backup_status_failed: Some backup status could not be read. Refresh to check the destination again.
frameleaf_backup_tested_description: Recovery points and restore verification have separate timestamps. Check both, whether you choose Cloud, Buddy, or both destinations.
frameleaf_backup_unread: Frameleaf couldn’t check {places} just now. What you see below may be out of date.
frameleaf_backup_versions_description: Deleted or changed something by mistake? Older versions let you go back. Nothing still needed by a kept version is ever removed.
frameleaf_backup_who_description: How much of each person’s library Cloud Backup holds. Each person chooses what to back up from their own library, and what they chose stays theirs.
frameleaf_backup_who_load_failed: Who’s backed up couldn’t be read.
frameleaf_backup_who_local: Counted {when}. Your own storage keeps this on this server.

frameleaf_backup_who_not_reported: Counted {when}. It couldn’t be reported to Frameleaf Cloud.
frameleaf_backup_who_pending: Counted {when}. Not reported to Frameleaf Cloud yet; it’s tried again on its own.
frameleaf_backup_who_reported: Counted {when} and reported to Frameleaf Cloud.
frameleaf_backup_who_unknown_note: Not known for the newest backup

frameleaf_batch.exclusions_help: Unavailable and failed originals are excluded. Check each photo’s status below before downloading.
frameleaf_batch.export_counts: ZIP includes {included} prepared photos; {skipped} photos excluded.
frameleaf_batch.help: Export original photos together, edit them elsewhere, then review the returned files before creating new versions. Originals stay untouched.
frameleaf_batch.old_server: This server does not support batch external editing yet.
frameleaf_batch.prepare_help: Preparation is saved per photo. You can close this view and resume preparation later.
frameleaf_batch.reason_authentication_required: Sign in again to continue this batch.
frameleaf_batch.reason_batch_cancelled: Unfinished work was cancelled. Completed versions are retained.
frameleaf_batch.reason_credential_unavailable: The session or API key used to confirm this edit is no longer authorized. This version was kept inactive in Versions.
frameleaf_batch.reason_current_revision_changed: The working version changed after confirmation. This returned version was kept inactive in Versions.
frameleaf_batch.reason_develop_batch_quota: Your storage is full. Free some space, then retry this file.

frameleaf_batch.reason_permission_denied: This session cannot access the requested photos. Other authorized photos can still continue.
frameleaf_batch.reason_render_failed: The preview could not be rendered. Retry the stored version or review a corrected file.
frameleaf_batch.reason_source_changed: The original changed. Export it in a new batch before returning another edit.
frameleaf_batch.reason_source_unavailable: This source is unavailable or access changed. Other photos can still continue.
frameleaf_batch.reason_transfer_checksum: The file did not arrive intact. Choose it again and retry.
frameleaf_batch.reason_unknown: This operation failed. Refresh the batch and retry.
frameleaf_batch.reselect: Choose the returned files or folder again after reopening this page. Browser file selections are kept only while this view is open.
frameleaf_batch.review_again: Review these returned files again before importing.
frameleaf_batch.review_help: Check every match. Choose a photo for renamed or ambiguous files, or skip files you do not want to import. Nothing is imported until you confirm.
frameleaf_batch.title: Edit in another app

frameleaf_buddy_30_days_12_monthly_point: 30 days, 12 monthly points, and the latest complete backup
frameleaf_buddy_abandon_the_incomplete_r: Abandon the incomplete run and rescan? Complete restore points stay protected, and verified stored objects are reused.
frameleaf_buddy_all_users_media_metadata: All users’ media, metadata, the database, Frameleaf settings, preferences, and locally configured secrets are included. Add your Compose or other deployment inputs here; inaccessible files stop a run from being marked complete.
frameleaf_buddy_also_include_thumbnails_: Also include thumbnails and transcoded copies
frameleaf_buddy_an_encrypted_copy_of_you: An encrypted copy of your library on your buddy’s Frameleaf server. Cloud Backup can stay on too.
frameleaf_buddy_backup_failed: Your last backup did not finish.
frameleaf_buddy_block_all_peer_access_im: Block all peer access immediately? The encrypted vault stays on disk.
frameleaf_buddy_both_servers_need_a_comp: Both servers need a compatible Frameleaf version, Cloud sign-in, and an active subscription for new backups. Buddy disk storage has no Frameleaf storage charge; relay transfers use your plan’s relay allowance.
frameleaf_buddy_buddy_backup_is_unavaila: Buddy Backup is unavailable. Try again.
frameleaf_buddy_capacity_too_small: The offered capacity is smaller than the estimated originals. Ask your buddy to increase it before the initial backup.
frameleaf_buddy_choose_a_frameleaf_buddy: Choose a Frameleaf Buddy recovery kit under 64 KB.
frameleaf_buddy_choose_an_empty_director: Choose an empty directory outside all photo and external-library paths. Receiving stops before free space falls below 10 GB or 10% of the volume.
frameleaf_buddy_choose_an_encrypted_reco: Choose an encrypted recovery package under 40 KB.
frameleaf_buddy_confirm_the_other_server: Confirm the other server and key with your buddy before continuing. Storage contributions do not need to match.
frameleaf_buddy_count_selected_choose_up: {count} selected · Choose up to 100 items, or restore a whole album.
frameleaf_buddy_coverage_unavailable: Reconnect unavailable library mounts and make the declared configuration files readable before continuing. Server identity keys cannot be included.
frameleaf_buddy_deployment_configuration: Deployment configuration files, one absolute path per line
frameleaf_buddy_deployment_settings_help: Select the environment variable names to include in encrypted snapshots. Values are read on this server. Hold Command or Ctrl to select more than one. Include both shutdown grace and deadline when selecting either.
frameleaf_buddy_direct_or_relay: On the same home network, your buddy connects directly to this server without a Frameleaf Cloud plan. Away from home, your buddy reaches this server (at its direct address, its Public server URL or through the relay) only while you have a Frameleaf Cloud plan.
frameleaf_buddy_each_direction_keeps_30_: Each direction keeps 30 days and 12 monthly restore points. Both sides enforce their configured transfer limits.
frameleaf_buddy_end_this_pairing_uploads: End this pairing? Uploads stop now; restore access lasts 30 days.
frameleaf_buddy_ending_a_pairing_stops_u: Ending a pairing stops uploads and keeps restore access for 30 days. Blocking revokes access immediately. Neither action removes the hosted vault.
frameleaf_buddy_estimate_detail: The initial backup also includes metadata, edits, project files and declared configuration. The compressed database size may differ. Allow space for retained versions and local encrypted staging.
frameleaf_buddy_fill_missing_items_and_k: Fill missing items and keep current changes
frameleaf_buddy_find_your_account_id_and: Find your account ID and pending invitations on the
frameleaf_buddy_for_a_replacement_server: For a replacement server, sign in to Cloud and rebind the pairing before importing your kit. Reattach the original media and external-library mount paths before full server recovery.
frameleaf_buddy_full_server_recovery_rep: Full-server recovery replaces the database. Existing sessions and unfinished jobs are invalidated before the library reopens.
frameleaf_buddy_generate_a_new_key_versi: Generate a new key version? Save and verify the replacement kit, which also contains your older keys.
frameleaf_buddy_hosting_capacity: Available for hosting after free-space reserve
frameleaf_buddy_link_required: Link this Frameleaf server to your Cloud account before pairing.
frameleaf_buddy_matching_start_and_end_t: Matching start and end times allow transfers all day. Restores take priority and use your transfer limits.
frameleaf_buddy_new_buddy_backups_are_no: New Buddy backups are not enabled on this server. Existing restore points remain available.
frameleaf_buddy_no_accessible_complete_r: No accessible complete restore points are available. Check your buddy’s connection and your recovery kit.
frameleaf_buddy_only_encrypted_storage_i: You provide encrypted storage only. Your buddy’s photos never appear in your Frameleaf library or restore browser.
frameleaf_buddy_open_buddy_backup_in_you: Open Buddy Backup in your Cloud account
frameleaf_buddy_overwrite_and_keep_a_rol: Overwrite and keep a rollback copy
frameleaf_buddy_overwritten_files_will_b: Overwritten files will be kept in rollback copies.
frameleaf_buddy_pair_two_cloud_linked_fr: Pair two Cloud-linked Frameleaf servers. Each owner chooses how much storage to offer. Your photos, albums, and settings are encrypted before they leave this server.
frameleaf_buddy_partial_restores_keep_cu: Partial restores keep current sharing permissions.
frameleaf_buddy_reattach_the_original_st: Reattach the original storage mounts first. Existing overwritten files and the current database are retained as rollback copies.
frameleaf_buddy_recover_selected_photos_: Recover selected photos, an album, your library, settings, or the entire server.
frameleaf_buddy_recover_your_own_photos_: Recover your own photos and albums from a dated backup. Unlock your PIN to continue.
frameleaf_buddy_recovery_kit_imported_yo: Recovery kit imported. Your restore points are available below.
frameleaf_buddy_recovery_package_unlocke: Recovery package unlocked and imported on this server.
frameleaf_buddy_restore_status_is_unavai: Restore status is unavailable. Unlock your PIN and refresh; the verified checkpoint is kept.
frameleaf_buddy_send_a_small_encrypted_f: Send a small encrypted file, download it, and verify it before the first library backup.
frameleaf_buddy_send_this_private_invita: Send this private invitation to your buddy. It expires in 24 hours.
frameleaf_buddy_server_licence_required: Both servers need a Server licence to start a new Buddy Backup pairing. Without a Frameleaf Cloud plan, the two servers connect only on the same home network.
frameleaf_buddy_the_encrypted_connection: The encrypted connection is verified. Your initial backup is queued.
frameleaf_buddy_the_files_have_been_down: The files have been downloaded and verified. Applying this recovery closes the library in maintenance mode. Full-server recovery replaces the database, restores users and settings, and signs everyone out.
frameleaf_buddy_this_recovery_kit_unlock: This recovery kit unlocks your backups. Save it somewhere other than this server, then select the saved file to verify it.
frameleaf_buddy_this_restore_is_unavaila: This restore is unavailable. Unlock your PIN and try again.
frameleaf_buddy_unknown_sizes: {count} items do not have a recorded size; the estimate is incomplete.
frameleaf_buddy_unlock_a_package_downloa: Unlock a package downloaded from Cloud
frameleaf_buddy_upload_this_encrypted_pa: Upload this encrypted package on the Buddy page in your Cloud account. Keep the passphrase separately.
frameleaf_buddy_verified_and_staged_appl: Verified and staged. Apply this recovery to continue.
frameleaf_buddy_wrapping_and_unlocking_h: Wrapping and unlocking happen on this Frameleaf server. Cloud stores only the encrypted package and never receives this passphrase.
frameleaf_buddy_you_can_close_this_dialo: You can close this dialog. Verified progress survives a server restart.
frameleaf_buddy_your_buddy_can_open_this: Your buddy can open this Cloud invitation or paste it into Buddy Backup on their own server.
frameleaf_buddy_your_saved_recovery_kit_: Your saved recovery kit is verified.

frameleaf_hardware_fix_amd_step_1: Find the render group's number on the host: stat -c '%g' /dev/dri/renderD128
frameleaf_hardware_fix_amd_step_2: Video transcoding needs /dev/dri. ROCm analysis also needs /dev/kfd and the ROCm image (about 35 GB free disk).
frameleaf_hardware_fix_intel_step_1: Find the render group's number on the host: stat -c '%g' /dev/dri/renderD128
frameleaf_hardware_fix_intel_step_2: Use numbers in group_add; group names differ between the host and the image.
frameleaf_hardware_fix_intel_step_3: Arc cards need host kernel 6.2 or newer.
frameleaf_hardware_fix_macos_step_1: There is nothing to change in docker compose: Docker Desktop can't pass a Mac's GPU to containers.
frameleaf_hardware_fix_macos_step_2: Send heavier work to Frameleaf Cloud in Where each job runs, or run Frameleaf on a Linux machine with a GPU.
frameleaf_hardware_fix_nvidia_step_1: Install the NVIDIA driver (545 or newer) and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the host.
frameleaf_hardware_fix_nvidia_step_2: Run: sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker && sudo systemctl restart docker
frameleaf_hardware_fix_nvidia_step_3: Remove any /dev/dri mapping from these services; NVIDIA does not use it.
frameleaf_hardware_fix_render_group_step: Find the render group's number on the host: stat -c '%g' /dev/dri/renderD128
Add that number to group_add in both containers; group names differ between the host and the image.
frameleaf_hardware_fix_rocm_gfx_step_1: Set HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION for the machine-learning container to the nearest target ROCm supports, then recreate it.
frameleaf_hardware_fix_unraid_step_1: In each container's template, add --runtime=nvidia under Extra Parameters.
frameleaf_hardware_fix_unraid_step_2: Set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to the card's UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin, and NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES to all.
frameleaf_hardware_fix_unraid_step_3: Make sure the card isn't bound to a virtual machine (VFIO) in Tools → System Devices.
frameleaf_hardware_fix_wrong_gpu_step_1: Find the graphics card's render node on the host: ls -l /dev/dri/by-path
frameleaf_hardware_fix_wrong_gpu_step_2: Map only that node into both containers, by its PCI path, so the integrated GPU is never picked first.
frameleaf_hardware_fix_wsl2_step_1: Install only the Windows GPU driver; do not install a Linux driver inside WSL.
frameleaf_hardware_issues_description: Until this is resolved, work runs on the processor.
frameleaf_hardware_ml_purpose: ML container · search, faces, captions and restoration
frameleaf_hardware_problem_compose_count: The GPU reservation sets both count and device_ids, or leaves out the gpu entry. Use only one of count or device_ids, and always list gpu.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_cpu_image: The machine-learning container runs the processor image. Use the image that matches your GPU: -cuda, -openvino or -rocm.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_dri_missing: /dev/dri is not passed into the container, or the host driver is not loaded.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_kfd_missing: ROCm analysis needs /dev/kfd as well as /dev/dri, and the video and render groups.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_macos: Docker Desktop runs containers in a Linux virtual machine with no GPU. This is expected: work runs on the processor, and heavier work can go to Frameleaf Cloud.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_nvenc_video: The server container can see the card but not its video encoder. Add video next to gpu in its GPU reservation.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_nvidia_arch: This card is older than the GPU image supports. Work runs on the processor instead.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_nvidia_bf16: This card has no bf16 or FlashAttention support, which need an RTX 30 series card or newer. Models that use them run slower here; pick a lighter model, or run the heaviest ones on Frameleaf Cloud.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_nvidia_dri: /dev/dri is how Intel and AMD cards are shared. NVIDIA cards need the toolkit and a GPU reservation in docker compose.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_nvidia_driver: The host driver is older than the CUDA image needs (driver 545 or newer). Update the host driver, or use the processor image until you can.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_nvidia_runtim: The compose file asks for the nvidia runtime, but Docker does not know it. Configure the toolkit, or use a GPU reservation instead of runtime: nvidia.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_nvidia_toolki: Docker cannot hand the NVIDIA card to containers. The NVIDIA Container Toolkit is missing or Docker was not configured after installing it.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_nvml_lost: Docker's cgroup handling dropped GPU access after a reload. Restart the container; switching the toolkit to CDI mode prevents it.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_openvino_cpu_: The analysis container cannot reach the Intel GPU: /dev/dri is missing, the image is not the OpenVINO one, or the host kernel is too old for Arc (6.2 or newer).
frameleaf_hardware_problem_render_group: The render node belongs to a group the container does not run with. Add the host's render group to the container by its number.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_render_permis: The container is not in the host's render group. Add the group by its number; names differ between the host and the image.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_rocm_gfx: ROCm was not built for this card. RX 6000 cards usually need HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=10.3.0; otherwise use the processor.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_snap_docker: The snap package keeps its settings elsewhere. Install Docker from Docker's own apt repository.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_unraid: The container template is missing --runtime=nvidia or the right NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, or the card is reserved for a virtual machine.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_wrong_gpu: renderD128 and renderD129 can swap between restarts. Map the card's own node by its PCI path.
frameleaf_hardware_problem_wsl2: WSL2 shares the GPU through /dev/dxg, not /dev/dri. Use the WSL2 settings; Quick Sync is not available there. For NVIDIA install only the Windows driver.

frameleaf_intel_captions_change_body: To rewrite the captions on the photos you already have, use “Update captions now” after saving. Descriptions written by hand are kept while “Keep what I wrote myself” is on.
frameleaf_intel_captions_change_body_hou: Rewriting the captions on the {total} photos you already have takes about {count, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} at the recent pace: use “Update captions now” after saving. Descriptions written by hand are kept while “Keep what I wrote myself” is on.
frameleaf_intel_captions_change_body_min: Rewriting the captions on the {total} photos you already have takes about {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} at the recent pace: use “Update captions now” after saving. Descriptions written by hand are kept while “Keep what I wrote myself” is on.
frameleaf_intel_captions_change_title: These choices apply to photos added from now on
frameleaf_intel_captions_device_help: Leave as AUTO unless the computer has more than one.
frameleaf_intel_captions_extra_help: Anything else captions should follow, up to 2,000 characters.
frameleaf_intel_captions_fallback_help: Used when the main model isn’t available. It must be installed too.
frameleaf_intel_captions_hardware_help: CUDA is for NVIDIA cards and OpenVINO is for Intel. Choosing one also picks the caption and private-photo models that suit it. This does not install anything.
frameleaf_intel_captions_kept: Descriptions written by hand are kept
frameleaf_intel_captions_kept_help: Writing captions again only replaces what Frameleaf wrote. This follows the setting “Keep what I wrote myself”, which is on.
frameleaf_intel_captions_kept_help_off: The setting “Keep what I wrote myself” is off, so writing captions again can replace a description written by hand.
frameleaf_intel_captions_kept_open_label: Open the setting Keep what I wrote myself
frameleaf_intel_captions_length_custom_h: Custom: about {count, plural, one {# sentence} other {# sentences}}, in its own writing style. Both are under Advanced.
frameleaf_intel_captions_length_detailed: Detailed: up to six sentences, with colours, weather and what people are doing. Longer captions are not always more accurate.
frameleaf_intel_captions_length_medium_h: Medium: two or three sentences. “Two people paddle a red canoe on a calm lake at sunset. Mountains rise behind them.”
frameleaf_intel_captions_length_short_he: Short: one sentence. “Two people paddle a red canoe on a lake.”
frameleaf_intel_captions_list_locked: Words allowed in captions of Locked photos
frameleaf_intel_captions_list_locked_hel: One per line. This does not change who can see those photos.
frameleaf_intel_captions_list_medical: Words allowed for medical things in view
frameleaf_intel_captions_list_medical_he: One per line. Visible things only, such as a cast or a wheelchair. Captions never name a condition.
frameleaf_intel_captions_list_preferred_: One per line. Captions and tags use these words when they fit.
frameleaf_intel_captions_look_for_help: Mentioned only when they can be seen in the photo.
frameleaf_intel_captions_model_custom: Another model, by its Hugging Face name…
frameleaf_intel_captions_model_name_help: The model’s Hugging Face name. It must be installed on the computer doing the work.
frameleaf_intel_captions_name_sure_help: From 0 to 1. Higher names fewer people. Fixing a face updates its captions.
frameleaf_intel_captions_names_help: Captions say “Jamie at the lake”. People you haven’t named stay unnamed.
frameleaf_intel_captions_never_help: Captions leave these out. Check a few after changing this list: it can’t be guaranteed.
frameleaf_intel_captions_no_photos: There are no photos to try it on yet.
frameleaf_intel_captions_off_body: Captions already written are kept and still used by search. New photos get none.
frameleaf_intel_captions_overnight_help: New photos are captioned soon after they arrive. Rewriting many captions waits for the night.
frameleaf_intel_captions_own_help: For experts: replaces the built-in caption instructions with your own text.
frameleaf_intel_captions_own_reset: Start again from the built-in text
frameleaf_intel_captions_own_text_help: '{schema}', '{names}', '{vocabulary}' and '{style_hint}' are filled in for each photo. Keep '{schema}', or captions can’t be read back.
frameleaf_intel_captions_pending_body: Photos you already have keep their old captions until they are updated.
frameleaf_intel_captions_pending_title: Caption choices changed since the captions were written
frameleaf_intel_captions_sample_failed: No caption could be written for this photo.
frameleaf_intel_captions_schema_missing_: If the schema placeholder is missing
frameleaf_intel_captions_some_body: A photo can be found by its caption as soon as it is written. Use “Update captions now” to write the rest.
frameleaf_intel_captions_some_waiting: {count, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} waiting now. A photo can be found by its caption as soon as it is written.
frameleaf_intel_captions_try: Try it on a few photos
frameleaf_intel_captions_try_failed: The sample captions could not be written. Check that the computer doing this work is on, then try again.
frameleaf_intel_captions_try_help: Writes sample captions with the choices above. Nothing in your library changes.
frameleaf_intel_captions_videos_help: Adds captions to {count, plural, one {# moment} other {# moments}} in each video. It takes longer, and speech is not written down.
frameleaf_intel_captions_videos_help_unk: Adds captions to a few moments in each video. It takes longer, and speech is not written down.
frameleaf_intel_captions_where_help: On the computer chosen for captions in Where work runs.
frameleaf_intel_captions_where_section: Where and when captions are written
frameleaf_intel_captions_write_help: A sentence or two about each photo. Search uses them.
frameleaf_intel_captions_writing: Writing sample captions for three of your newest photos…
frameleaf_intel_categories_match: When a photo matches a category
frameleaf_intel_categories_match_review_: Ask me first: matches wait in a list for you to accept. Nothing is tagged until you do. Nothing is ever archived unless you choose that for a category.
frameleaf_intel_categories_match_tag_hel: Tag it automatically: matching photos get the category’s tag straight away. You can remove it from any photo. Nothing is ever archived unless you choose that for a category.
frameleaf_intel_categories_suggest_help: Describe a category, such as “birthday parties”, and see which photos match before anything is tagged.
frameleaf_intel_checks_every_help: How often each address is checked.
frameleaf_intel_checks_help: Frameleaf stops sending work to an address that doesn’t answer, and tries it again later.
frameleaf_intel_checks_wait_help: How long a check waits before the address counts as not answering.
frameleaf_intel_custom_model_help: Custom: {model}. Choose one of the others to replace it.
frameleaf_intel_faces_advanced_explain: A “model” is the trained program that recognises faces: a larger one is more accurate and slower. The three numbers are set by “How carefully to group”.
frameleaf_intel_faces_alike: How alike two faces must be
frameleaf_intel_faces_alike_help: From 0.1 to 2. Lower is stricter and makes fewer wrong matches.
frameleaf_intel_faces_clarity_help: From 0.1 to 1. Higher ignores blurry or tiny faces in the background.
frameleaf_intel_faces_grouping_balanced_: Balanced: someone appears after 3 photos. A few look-alikes may need splitting.
frameleaf_intel_faces_grouping_careful_h: Fewer mistakes: someone appears after 5 clear photos. The same person may show up twice and need merging.
frameleaf_intel_faces_grouping_custom_he: Custom: someone appears after {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}. The numbers are under Advanced.
frameleaf_intel_faces_grouping_more_help: Group more photos: someone appears after 2 photos, including blurry and side-on faces. Expect more look-alikes to split.
frameleaf_intel_faces_import: Use people tags saved by other apps
frameleaf_intel_faces_import_help: If Lightroom, digiKam or another app saved who is in a photo, show those people here.
frameleaf_intel_faces_import_new_body: To include the photos you already have, read their details again from Background work after saving.
frameleaf_intel_faces_import_new_title: This applies to photos added from now on
frameleaf_intel_faces_model_help: Faces already found are checked with a new model when face detection runs again from Background work. Your corrections are kept.
frameleaf_intel_faces_off_body: People you have named stay named. New photos are not added to them.
frameleaf_intel_faces_on_body: People are recognised in new photos soon after they arrive. Names and fixes you make are kept.
frameleaf_intel_faces_photos_needed_help: 1 or more. Fewer shows people sooner, including some you may not know.
frameleaf_intel_faces_pledge_body: Every “same person” and “different person” choice you make is kept when faces are checked again.
frameleaf_intel_faces_reading_body: {count, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} still waiting to be checked for faces.
frameleaf_intel_faces_recognise_help: Groups photos of the same person so you can name them. Names and fixes you make are kept.
frameleaf_intel_faces_redo_said_now: Saved. Faces are being grouped again; people pages update as it goes.
frameleaf_intel_faces_redo_said_tonight: Saved. Faces are grouped again tonight, in the overnight schedule.
frameleaf_intel_faces_regroup_body: New photos follow it straight away. The names you gave and every “same person” or “different person” choice are kept.
frameleaf_intel_faces_regroup_estimate: Saving this groups the faces in all {count, number} photos and videos again, {time}
frameleaf_intel_faces_regroup_title: Saving this changes how faces are grouped
frameleaf_intel_feature_descriptions_det: Captions and tags that make photos easier to find
frameleaf_intel_feature_documents_detail: Find photos by the words in them
frameleaf_intel_feature_faces_detail: Recognise the people in your photos
frameleaf_intel_feature_master_off_note: Comes back with the switch above
frameleaf_intel_feature_sensitive-detect: Suggest private photos that may belong in Locked
frameleaf_intel_feature_smart-albums_det: Albums like Travel, Food and Pets that fill themselves
frameleaf_intel_feature_smart-search_det: Find photos by describing what’s in them
frameleaf_intel_features_description: Each one can be turned off by itself. Open a feature to change how it behaves.
frameleaf_intel_helper_add_help: For a second helper program, used when the first one doesn’t answer.
frameleaf_intel_helper_address_help: Where the helper program answers, such as http://frameleaf-machine-learning:3003. More than one address is tried in order.
frameleaf_intel_helper_changed: The new address is used once you save.
frameleaf_intel_helper_explain: Recognition is done by a helper program, on this server or on another computer. Frameleaf checks that it is answering and waits a short time for each reply.
frameleaf_intel_landing_off_body: You can still find photos by date, place, album and file name. Nothing new is read. What was already read is kept, so turning this back on carries on from here.
frameleaf_intel_landing_on_body: Nothing is waiting to be read, so search, people, text and captions are up to date.
frameleaf_intel_landing_overnight_help: New photos are read soon after they arrive. Reading a whole library again waits for the night.
frameleaf_intel_landing_paused_body: The computer that does this work isn’t answering. Search still works for photos already read. {count, plural, =0 {New photos wait, and nothing is lost.} one {# photo is waiting, and nothing is lost.} other {# photos are waiting, and nothing is lost.}}
frameleaf_intel_landing_reading_body: {count, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} still waiting to be read. Photos already read can be searched now.
frameleaf_intel_locked_advanced_explain: A “model” is the trained program that looks for private photos. What it finds stays on this server. “How cautious to be” sets the number.
frameleaf_intel_locked_caution_balanced_: Balanced: suggests most private photos, with an occasional beach or bath photo by mistake.
frameleaf_intel_locked_caution_custom_he: Custom: suggests a photo once it scores {score}. The number is under Advanced.
frameleaf_intel_locked_caution_more_help: Suggest more: misses very little. Expect more ordinary photos among the suggestions.
frameleaf_intel_locked_caution_sure_help: Only the obvious: suggests only photos that are clearly private. Some will be missed.
frameleaf_intel_locked_device_help: Which processor or graphics card does the checking. AUTO lets Frameleaf choose.
frameleaf_intel_locked_hide_help: Photos this check flags stay out of library views until the session is unlocked with the PIN.
frameleaf_intel_locked_model_help: Type another only if you know it is installed.
frameleaf_intel_locked_off: Suggesting photos to lock is off
frameleaf_intel_locked_off_body: Photos already in Locked stay there. No new suggestions are made.
frameleaf_intel_locked_on: Suggesting photos to lock is on
frameleaf_intel_locked_on_body: New photos are checked soon after they arrive. Each suggestion is shown only to the photo’s owner.
frameleaf_intel_locked_pledge_body: A photo stays in Locked even if someone removes its tags. Only its owner’s PIN opens it.
frameleaf_intel_locked_reading_body: {count, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} still waiting to be checked.
frameleaf_intel_locked_recheck_body: New photos follow it straight away. To check the photos you already have again, start it from Background work after saving. Photos already in Locked stay there, whatever the new check finds.
frameleaf_intel_locked_recheck_title: Saving this changes which photos are suggested
frameleaf_intel_locked_suggest_help: Looks for private photos, such as nudity, and suggests moving them to Locked. Only the photo’s owner sees the suggestion.
frameleaf_intel_locked_threshold_help: From 0.01 to 1. Higher suggests fewer photos.
frameleaf_intel_locked_what_hides_help: Who can open Locked, and what it hides, is set in one place: Access & security.
frameleaf_intel_master_help: One switch for every feature below. Turning it off keeps what has already been read.
frameleaf_intel_master_off_body: Every feature is off until the one switch on Search & intelligence is on again. The choices on this page are kept.
frameleaf_intel_master_off_title: Search and recognition is turned off
frameleaf_intel_redo_failed: The settings were not saved, or the work could not be started
frameleaf_intel_redo_said_now: Saved. Reading has started; results come back as each photo is read.
frameleaf_intel_redo_said_tonight: Saved. Reading starts tonight, in the overnight schedule.
frameleaf_intel_search_describe_help: Type what you remember: “birthday cake”, “red canoe at sunset”. It works alongside every other way of searching.
frameleaf_intel_search_model_explain: A “model” is the trained program that turns photos and words into something that can be compared. Search quality picks one for you.
frameleaf_intel_search_model_help: Type another only if you know it is installed on the computer that does this work.
frameleaf_intel_search_off_body: You can still search by date, place, person, album and file name. Look-alike photos can’t be found while this is off.
frameleaf_intel_search_on_body: Photos and videos can be found by describing them, like “dog on a beach”.
frameleaf_intel_search_pledge: Changing the search quality always reads the library again
frameleaf_intel_search_pledge_body: Searching by date, place, person and file name keeps working. Your own tags and captions are kept.
frameleaf_intel_search_quality_balanced_: Balanced: good results for everyday searches.
frameleaf_intel_search_quality_best_help: Most accurate: understands unusual descriptions and other languages better. Much slower, so a graphics card or a second computer helps.
frameleaf_intel_search_quality_fast_help: Faster: suits a small server. May miss finer details, such as a breed of dog or a kind of flower.
frameleaf_intel_search_reading_body: {count, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} still waiting to be read. The photos already read can be found by describing them.
frameleaf_intel_search_reread_body: The old search results are cleared when you save, so describing a photo finds nothing until the photos are read again. Searching by date, place, person and file name keeps working. Your albums, tags and captions are not touched.
frameleaf_intel_search_reread_estimate: Saving this reads all {count, number} photos and videos again, {time}
frameleaf_intel_search_reread_title: Saving this means reading all photos and videos again
frameleaf_intel_tags_amount_balanced_hel: Balanced: up to 6 tags on a photo, with an occasional wrong one.
frameleaf_intel_tags_amount_custom_help: Custom: up to {count, plural, one {# tag} other {# tags}} on a photo. The numbers are under Advanced.
frameleaf_intel_tags_amount_few_help: Fewer, surer: up to 3 tags on a photo, and only the obvious ones.
frameleaf_intel_tags_amount_more_help: More tags: up to 12 tags on a photo. More to search by, and more to tidy.
frameleaf_intel_tags_most_help: From 1 to 20. Tags you added don’t count.
frameleaf_intel_tags_strictness_help: From 0 to 1. Higher gives fewer, surer tags. Set by “How many tags”.
frameleaf_intel_tags_suggest_help: Suggests tags from what is in each photo. Tags you added are always kept.
frameleaf_intel_tags_suggest_needs_searc: Tags are suggested by visual search, which is off. Turn it on in Visual search first.
frameleaf_intel_text_advanced_explain: A “model” is the trained program that reads text. “Languages to read” picks its language group, and “How much to read” sets the two scores.
frameleaf_intel_text_detail_help: From 1 to 4,096. Set by “Read small print”.
frameleaf_intel_text_kept: How sure a word must be to be kept
frameleaf_intel_text_kept_help: From 0.1 to 1. Higher keeps fewer mistakes and fewer words.
frameleaf_intel_text_language_multilingu: Chinese, Japanese, English and Latin-script languages
frameleaf_intel_text_languages_help: One group of alphabets at a time. Choose the one most of your photos use.
frameleaf_intel_text_model_help: The larger one reads more accurately and is several times slower. Only Chinese, Japanese and English has one.
frameleaf_intel_text_noticed: How clear text must be to be noticed
frameleaf_intel_text_noticed_help: From 0.1 to 1. Higher skips faint or partial text.
frameleaf_intel_text_off: Reading text in photos is off
frameleaf_intel_text_off_body: Words already read stay searchable. New photos are not read.
frameleaf_intel_text_on: Reading text in photos is on
frameleaf_intel_text_on_body: Signs, receipts and documents can be found by the words in them. New photos are read soon after they arrive.
frameleaf_intel_text_read_help: Makes signs, receipts and documents searchable by the words in them.
frameleaf_intel_text_reading_balanced_he: Balanced: signs, receipts and printed pages. Very faded or tiny text is skipped.
frameleaf_intel_text_reading_body: {count, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} still waiting to be read for text.
frameleaf_intel_text_reading_clear_help: Clear text only: signs, headings and printed pages. Fewest mistakes, and faded or small text is skipped.
frameleaf_intel_text_reading_custom_help: Custom: the two scores are under Advanced.
frameleaf_intel_text_reading_faint_help: Faint text too: also faded receipts and handwriting. More words to search by, and more of them wrong.
frameleaf_intel_text_receipts_help: Suggests the shop, the date and the total. Suggestions stay editable and show where they were read from.
frameleaf_intel_text_reread_body: New photos follow it straight away. To read the text in the photos you already have again, start it from Background work after saving. Search keeps finding the words already read.
frameleaf_intel_text_reread_title: Saving this changes how text is read
frameleaf_intel_text_small_print_help: Reads the fine print on receipts and documents. Slower, and needs more memory.
frameleaf_intel_where_help: On this server, by its helper program for recognition.
frameleaf_intel_where_silent: On this server’s helper program, which is not answering.
frameleaf_job_runs_help: Progress counts selected items once across all stages. Stage totals include follow-up and coordination work.
frameleaf_job_runs_items_unavailable: Item status is unavailable. The last known items are shown.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_dependency_fai: A prerequisite failed. Dependent work did not run.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_dependency_una: A required service or resource is unavailable. Work remains pending until it is available.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_dependency_wai: Waiting for a prerequisite to finish.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_destination-ca: Waiting for processing capacity on the destination.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_first_setup_pe: Imported regeneration is waiting for first setup prerequisites. No worker dispatch is expected yet.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_local-capacity: Waiting for local image processing capacity.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_needs_attentio: Some stages need attention before work can continue.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_no_dispatch_ba: Work has been ready for more than two minutes without dispatch. Check worker availability and queue settings.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_retry_backoff: A retry is waiting to be dispatched.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_source-unavail: The source required for processing is unavailable.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_stage_failed: Some stages failed. Other work may still be running.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_worker_unavail: No worker is available. Pending work is retained.
frameleaf_job_runs_reason_workload-disab: This workload is disabled. Pending work is retained.
frameleaf_job_runs_unavailable: Run status is unavailable. The last known progress is shown. Try refreshing.
frameleaf_jobs_account_counts_failed: Some counts for {name} could not be loaded. They show as unknown.
frameleaf_jobs_account_scope: Counts and job details: {name}. Queue controls and concurrency affect every account.
frameleaf_jobs_account_truncated: An account's counts come from the newest 1,000 jobs of each state, so a busier queue may hold more of its work.
frameleaf_jobs_active_across: {count} active across all accounts · {workers, plural, one {# worker} other {# workers}}
frameleaf_jobs_concurrency_fixed: Fixed at one to keep operations ordered
frameleaf_jobs_concurrency_footer: Concurrency changes join the settings review. They do not change a job’s destination or retry a failure.
frameleaf_jobs_concurrency_help: Set simultaneous jobs per server worker. Higher limits can compete for CPU, GPU memory, and storage bandwidth.
frameleaf_jobs_concurrency_invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000.
frameleaf_jobs_concurrency_note: Saved limits control the next jobs admitted. Active jobs continue; reducing the limit does not cancel them.
frameleaf_jobs_description: Keep indexing moving, resolve failures, and balance work across your server.
frameleaf_jobs_description_reminder: Description regeneration is waiting for your review.
frameleaf_jobs_detail_error_none: The server kept no error for this job.
frameleaf_jobs_empty_help: Choose another state or clear the search.
frameleaf_jobs_empty_help_account: No matching jobs for {name}. Other accounts may still have work in this queue.
frameleaf_jobs_feature_off: This feature is off. Enable it before starting a library scan.
frameleaf_jobs_history_help: Server-wide actions made on this device. These records describe queue commands, not completed processing.
frameleaf_jobs_jobs_load_failed: Jobs could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
frameleaf_jobs_manual_analytics_collect_: Record a new snapshot of library and server measurements for Library analytics.
frameleaf_jobs_manual_backup_database_de: Back up library records; original media needs its own backup.
frameleaf_jobs_manual_best_photos_backfi: Score the library again, including previously scored assets.
frameleaf_jobs_manual_help: Choose a task. Maintenance jobs run across the server.
frameleaf_jobs_manual_identical_files_ch: Read every original again, store identical files once, merge identical photos in each library and recover orphaned files.
frameleaf_jobs_manual_integrity_checksum: Move photos with checksum mismatches to Trash
Moves every photo and video listed under Checksum Mismatch to Trash.
Compare file contents with recorded checksums.
frameleaf_jobs_manual_integrity_missing_: Move photos with missing files to Trash
Moves every photo and video listed under Missing Files to Trash. If a drive is unplugged, reconnect it and run the check again first.
Scan for database references whose files are missing.
frameleaf_jobs_manual_integrity_untracke: Deletes every file listed under Untracked Files from disk. This cannot be undone.
Scan for files not tracked by library records.
frameleaf_jobs_manual_user_cleanup_descr: Process accounts already scheduled for permanent deletion.
frameleaf_jobs_name_asset_extract_metada: Find items to read metadata from
frameleaf_jobs_name_asset_metadata_postp: Update the library after reading metadata
frameleaf_jobs_name_asset_palette_queue_: Find items whose colours need reading
frameleaf_jobs_name_best_photos_score: Score a photo for Best Photos
frameleaf_jobs_name_best_photos_score_qu: Find photos to score for Best Photos
frameleaf_jobs_name_cloud_backup_schedul: Start a scheduled Frameleaf Cloud backup
frameleaf_jobs_name_cloud_backup_verify: Check whether a Frameleaf Cloud backup verification is due
frameleaf_jobs_name_cloud_ml_library_bat: Prepare smart search and find faces with Frameleaf Cloud
frameleaf_jobs_name_image_enrichment_pos: Continue image analysis and update the library
frameleaf_jobs_name_integrity_delete_rep: Clear integrity reports of one kind
frameleaf_jobs_name_library_remove_asset: Remove an item from a library
frameleaf_jobs_name_nsfw_detection: Check an image for Locked content
frameleaf_jobs_name_overnight_sequence: Overnight work, one step after another
frameleaf_jobs_name_partner_backfill: Copy a library to a partner
frameleaf_jobs_name_partner_copy_album: Copy an album to a partner
frameleaf_jobs_name_partner_copy_asset: Copy a photo to a partner
frameleaf_jobs_name_partner_propagate: Update partners' copies after an edit
frameleaf_jobs_name_pet_recognition_near: Look for a pet in similar photos
frameleaf_jobs_name_profile_image_repair: Replace profile pictures from Locked photos
frameleaf_jobs_name_push_backup_stale_ch: Check for phones whose backup stopped
frameleaf_jobs_name_smart_search_postpro: Update tags and categories after visual search indexing
frameleaf_jobs_name_studio_hdr_proxy_gen: Prepare an HDR video for Studio
frameleaf_jobs_no_queues_help: Try another name or clear the category and status filters.
frameleaf_jobs_notice_descriptions_alrea: Description work is already queued; nothing new was added.
frameleaf_jobs_notice_descriptions_cloud: Descriptions go to Frameleaf Cloud, which describes photos in batches. Describe them from Frameleaf Cloud processing, where the estimate comes first.
frameleaf_jobs_notice_smart_albums_alrea: A re-evaluation with this category scope is already queued.
frameleaf_jobs_pause_unavailable: Essential background work must stay available
frameleaf_jobs_queue_background_task_des: Essential cleanup, coordination, and follow-up tasks.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_backup_database_des: Create a backup of library records and configuration.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_editor_description: Render saved photo and video revisions.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_image_description_d: Describe visual content and generate useful tags.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_image_enrichment_de: Schedule enabled descriptions and Locked-content analysis.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_integrity_check_des: Verify file existence, tracking, and checksums.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_media_health_descri: Inspect missing or damaged library files.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_metadata_extraction: Read capture dates, camera details, location, and embedded metadata.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_migration_descripti: Migrate generated files into their current storage layout.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_pet_recognition_des: Suggest which of your pets appear in photos.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_sidecar_description: Discover sidecars or synchronize their metadata.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_smart_search_descri: Index visual content for semantic search.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_storage_template_mi: Move files according to the configured storage template.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_video_conversion_de: Create compatible playback copies from original videos.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_video_duplicate_det: Compare sampled video frames for duplicate detection.
frameleaf_jobs_queue_workflow_descriptio: Apply configured actions after library events.
frameleaf_jobs_queues_load_failed: The queues did not load. Try again.
frameleaf_jobs_review_acknowledge: I have reviewed the effect on this queue and all accounts.
frameleaf_jobs_review_clear_waiting: Remove waiting jobs from this queue. Active, delayed, and failed jobs remain. Original files are not deleted.
frameleaf_jobs_review_descriptions: Queue a full description pass for eligible assets using the saved settings. Existing active or waiting description work prevents a duplicate request.
frameleaf_jobs_review_descriptions_busy: Description work is already active or waiting. Keep a reminder to revisit this change later.
frameleaf_jobs_review_descriptions_defer: Keep a reminder to rerun descriptions after reviewing the saved model and prompt.
frameleaf_jobs_review_descriptions_disab: Enable descriptions before scheduling this task.
frameleaf_jobs_review_descriptions_estim: {count, plural, one {# eligible item} other {# eligible items}} · about {duration} with the saved model.
frameleaf_jobs_review_filter_note: The account you are viewing does not limit this command.
frameleaf_jobs_review_force: Queue a library-wide scan including previously processed assets. This can require substantial processing time.

frameleaf_play_card_decode: Read videos with the graphics card too

frameleaf_play_fact_videos_detail: For videos that won’t play everywhere

frameleaf_play_preview_blurry: Show a blurry preview while loading
